beats.text: Episode 2: the MapReduce model.
beats.zh: 第 2 集：MapReduce 模型。

beats.text: Last time, mrsequential put every pair from eight books into one slice in memory.
beats.zh: 上一集，mrsequential 把八本书的所有词对放进了内存里的同一个切片。

beats.text: On many machines there is no "one slice": each machine has only its own memory.
beats.zh: 换成很多台机器，就没有“同一个切片”了：每台机器只有自己的内存。

beats.text: Today: how the pairs are cut up so many machines can share the work.
beats.zh: 今天讲：词对怎么切开，让很多台机器分着做。

beats.text: Here is the whole episode in two sentences.
beats.zh: 先用两句话说完这一集。

beats.text: Every pair from book X goes into file mr-X-Y, where Y is the word's hash, mod 10.
beats.zh: 第 X 本书的每个词对，都进文件 mr-X-Y；Y 是这个词的哈希值对 10 取余。

beats.text: When every book is done, reducer Y reads column Y: every copy of its words, and nobody else's.
beats.zh: 等所有书都做完，第 Y 个 reducer 读第 Y 列：它那些词的全部副本，别人的一个也没有。

beats.text: Now the page, top to bottom. A: eight books, so eight map tasks, one row each.
beats.zh: 下面是这张图，从上往下。A：八本书，就是八个 map 任务，一本一行。

beats.text: B: Map turns a book into pairs, one per word: the word and "1".
beats.zh: B：Map 把一本书变成词对，每个词一对：这个词，和 "1"。

beats.text: C: each pair picks its column with ihash, mod 10, and is appended to mr-X-Y.
beats.zh: C：每个词对用 ihash 对 10 取余选出它的列，追加进 mr-X-Y。

beats.text: D: a gate. Reduce may start only when all eight map tasks have finished.
beats.zh: D：一道闸。所有八个 map 任务都完成，reduce 才能开始。

beats.text: E: reducer Y reads its column, sorts it, groups equal words, and writes mr-out-Y.
beats.zh: E：第 Y 个 reducer 读它那一列，排序，把相同的词归到一起，写出 mr-out-Y。

beats.text: We'll follow one word down this page: "of". Its path will light up as we go.
beats.zh: 我们跟着一个词 "of" 从上走到下。它走过的地方会一路亮起来。

beats.text: mrsequential admits the difference in a comment, right after the map loop.
beats.zh: mrsequential 在 map 循环后面的注释里自己说了区别。

beats.text: All the intermediate data sits in one place, rather than being partitioned into N by M buckets.
beats.zh: 所有中间数据都放在一个地方，而不是分进 N×M 个桶。

beats.text: "Intermediate data" means the pairs: Map's output, before Reduce has seen them.
beats.zh: “中间数据”就是那些词对：Map 的输出，还没交给 Reduce 的东西。

beats.text: So the pairs are cut twice: once by which book they came from, once by which bucket they go to.
beats.zh: 所以词对要切两刀：按来自哪本书切一次，按去哪个桶再切一次。

scenes.title: Where M and R Come From
scenes.zh: M 和 R 从哪来

beats.text: The first cut is free: one map task per input file. Eight books, so M is 8.
beats.zh: 第一刀是现成的：每个输入文件一个 map 任务。八本书，M 就是 8。

beats.text: A "task" is one piece of work a machine can be handed on its own.
beats.zh: “任务”就是能单独交给一台机器去做的一份活。

beats.text: The second number is nReduce, the number of reduce tasks. Where does it come from?
beats.zh: 第二个数是 nReduce，也就是 reduce 任务的个数。它从哪来？

beats.text: mrcoordinator.go hard-codes it: MakeCoordinator gets 10, every run.
beats.zh: mrcoordinator.go 写死了：每次都给 MakeCoordinator 传 10。

beats.text: Eight rows times ten columns: eighty intermediate files.
beats.zh: 八行乘十列：八十个中间文件。

beats.text: The lab suggests naming them mr-X-Y: X is the map task, Y is the reduce bucket.
beats.zh: Lab 建议把它们命名为 mr-X-Y：X 是 map 任务，Y 是 reduce 桶。

scenes.title: A Rule That Picks a Bucket

beats.text: Each pair must land in exactly one bucket. We need a rule. Let's try one on a toy.
beats.zh: 每个词对必须进恰好一个桶。我们需要一条规则，先拿玩具例子试试。

beats.text: Six words, three buckets: sea, see, sun, sky, sand, cat.
beats.zh: 六个词，三个桶：sea、see、sun、sky、sand、cat。

beats.text: Rule one: by first letter. a–h go to bucket 0, i–r to 1, s–z to 2.
beats.zh: 规则一：按首字母。a 到 h 进 0 号桶，i 到 r 进 1 号，s 到 z 进 2 号。

beats.text: How full is each bucket?
beats.zh: 每个桶有多满？

beats.text: Bucket 2 gets five words, bucket 0 gets one, bucket 1 gets none.
beats.zh: 2 号桶五个词，0 号桶一个，1 号桶一个都没有。

beats.text: Real books do the same. Across all eight, 2,691 distinct words start with s, and only 12 with z.
beats.zh: 真实的书也一样。八本书里，s 开头的不同单词有 2,691 个，z 开头的只有 12 个。

beats.text: Rule two, still a toy: add up the letters' places in the alphabet, a is 1, z is 26.
beats.zh: 规则二，还是玩具：把字母在字母表里的位置加起来，a 是 1，z 是 26。

beats.text: sea is 19 plus 5 plus 1: 25. Mod 3 leaves 1, so bucket 1.
beats.zh: sea 是 19 加 5 加 1：25。对 3 取余剩 1，进 1 号桶。

beats.text: Do all six and each bucket gets exactly two words.
beats.zh: 六个词都算完，每个桶正好两个词。

beats.text: The key part: sea gives 25 whichever book it came from. Same word, same bucket, every time.
beats.zh: 关键在这里：不管 sea 来自哪本书，算出来都是 25。同一个词，永远进同一个桶。

beats.text: A rule like that is a hash function: it scrambles the input, but never changes its answer.
beats.zh: 这样的规则就叫哈希函数：把输入打乱，但答案永远不变。

beats.text: The real rule is ihash, a hash function given to you in worker.go.
beats.zh: 真正的规则是 ihash，worker.go 里发给你的哈希函数。

beats.text: It's FNV-1a: start from a fixed 32-bit number, then take the word one byte at a time.
beats.zh: 它是 FNV-1a：从一个固定的 32 位数开始，然后逐字节处理这个词。

beats.text: For each byte: XOR it in, which flips the bits where the byte has a 1.
beats.zh: 每个字节：先异或进去，也就是在这个字节为 1 的位上把位翻过来。

beats.text: Then multiply by a fixed prime, and keep only the low 32 bits.
beats.zh: 再乘一个固定的质数，只保留低 32 位。

beats.text: "o" is 0x6f. XOR, multiply: 0xea0c329e.
beats.zh: "o" 是 0x6f。异或、相乘：得到 0xea0c329e。

beats.text: "f" is 0x66. XOR, multiply: 0x69343c68, which is 1,765,031,016.
The mask clears the top bit, so the result is never negative. Here it changes nothing.
beats.zh: 掩码把最高位清零，结果就不会是负数。这里它没改变任何东西。

beats.text: Mod 10 gives 6. "of" goes to bucket 6.
beats.zh: 对 10 取余得 6。"of" 进 6 号桶。

beats.text: Here is the same thing in worker.go: New32a is FNV-1a, and the comment says to take it mod NReduce.
beats.zh: worker.go 里是同一件事：New32a 就是 FNV-1a，注释写着要对 NReduce 取余。

beats.text: And the real run agrees: "of" lands in bucket 6.
beats.zh: 真实运行也一样："of" 落在 6 号桶。

beats.text: Like the toy, ihash depends only on the word, not on the book or the machine.
beats.zh: 和玩具例子一样，ihash 只看这个词，不管它来自哪本书、哪台机器。

beats.text: "of" appears in all eight books. How many intermediate files hold it?
beats.zh: "of" 八本书里都有。有几个中间文件装着它？

beats.text: Eight: mr-0-6 through mr-7-6. One cell in every row, all in column 6.
beats.zh: 八个：从 mr-0-6 到 mr-7-6。每一行一格，全在第 6 列。

beats.text: Frankenstein's cell has 2,746 of them. Sherlock Holmes's has 2,734. Being Earnest's has 485.
beats.zh: 《弗兰肯斯坦》那格有 2,746 个，《福尔摩斯》那格有 2,734 个，《认真的重要》那格有 485 个。

beats.text: And no other column holds a single "of".
beats.zh: 其他列一个 "of" 都没有。

beats.text: So far, on our page: A, rows are map tasks, one per book.
beats.zh: 到目前为止，在这张图上：A，行是 map 任务，一本书一行。

beats.text: B and C: each pair's word, hashed mod 10, picks its column.
beats.zh: B 和 C：每个词对的词，哈希后对 10 取余，选出它的列。

beats.text: "of" has reached column 6, in eight files. Next comes the gate, D.
beats.zh: "of" 已经到了第 6 列，分在八个文件里。下一步是闸门 D。

beats.text: Reducer 6 wants to start. Map task 7, Tom Sawyer, is still running. Can it?
beats.zh: 6 号 reducer 想开始了，map 任务 7《汤姆·索亚》还在跑。它能开始吗？

beats.text: No. Column 6 is missing its last file, so its count for "of" would be 1,565 short.
beats.zh: 不能。第 6 列还缺最后一个文件，"of" 的次数会少 1,565。

beats.text: So reduce starts only after every map task has finished. The lab says the same.
beats.zh: 所以 reduce 要等所有 map 任务都完成才开始。Lab 也是这么要求的。

beats.text: Who checks this gate, and how, is the coordinator's job: episode 3.
beats.zh: 谁来守这道闸、怎么守，是协调者的事：第 3 集讲。

beats.text: Before the real column, one toy. Five pairs: of, a, of, the, a.
beats.zh: 读真实的列之前，先看一个玩具例子。五个词对：of、a、of、the、a。

beats.text: Sort them by word: a, a, of, of, the. Equal words now sit next to each other.
beats.zh: 按词排序：a、a、of、of、the。相同的词现在挨在一起了。

beats.text: Walk the list and cut it where the word changes: three runs.
beats.zh: 沿着列表走，词一变就切一刀：三段。

beats.text: Each run goes to Reduce once. wc.go's Reduce just counts: a 2, of 2, the 1.
beats.zh: 每一段交给 Reduce 一次。wc.go 的 Reduce 只是数个数：a 2、of 2、the 1。

beats.text: Now for real. Reducer 6 reads its column: eight files, mr-0-6 through mr-7-6.
beats.zh: 现在来真的。6 号 reducer 读它那一列：八个文件，mr-0-6 到 mr-7-6。

beats.text: That's 105,743 pairs, with every "of" somewhere among them.
beats.zh: 一共 105,743 个词对，所有的 "of" 都在里面。

beats.text: From here it's exactly the toy, and exactly mrsequential: sort by key.
beats.zh: 从这里开始就和玩具例子、和 mrsequential 一模一样：按键排序。

beats.text: The 13,536 "of" pairs now sit together. Walk each run of equal keys and call Reduce.
beats.zh: 13,536 个 "of" 挨在了一起。走过每一段相同的键，调用 Reduce。

beats.text: The lab says you may reuse this sorting and output code from mrsequential.
beats.zh: Lab 说可以直接复用 mrsequential 里的排序和输出代码。

beats.text: Reducer 6 writes mr-out-6. One of its lines: of 13536. "of" has reached the bottom of the page.
beats.zh: 6 号 reducer 写出 mr-out-6，其中一行：of 13536。"of" 走到了这张图的最底下。

beats.text: Here's a real run of this data path on the eight books, with nReduce set to 10.
beats.zh: 这是这条数据路径在八本书上的真实运行，nReduce 设为 10。

beats.text: It wrote exactly 80 intermediate files, and ten output files.
beats.zh: 它正好写了 80 个中间文件和 10 个输出文件。

beats.text: Distinct words per bucket: between 2,173 and 2,251. ihash spreads the words evenly.
beats.zh: 每个桶的不同单词数：2,173 到 2,251 之间。ihash 把词分得很均匀。

beats.text: But pairs per bucket range from 39,508 to 105,743. Why so uneven?
beats.zh: 但每个桶的词对数从 39,508 到 105,743。为什么差这么多？

beats.text: Because a few words are huge. Bucket 6 holds "of", 13,536 pairs. Bucket 2 holds "the", 29,748.
beats.zh: 因为少数几个词特别多。6 号桶有 "of"，13,536 个；2 号桶有 "the"，29,748 个。

beats.text: A hash balances words, not work. One very common word always lands on one reducer.
beats.zh: 哈希平衡的是词，不是工作量。一个特别常见的词，总是落在同一个 reducer 上。

beats.text: How does Lab 1 know your buckets are right? Look at TestWc in mr_test.go.
beats.zh: Lab 1 怎么知道你分桶分对了？看 mr_test.go 里的 TestWc。

beats.text: First, mkCorrectOutput runs mrsequential on the same books and sorts its output.
beats.zh: 先是 mkCorrectOutput：在同样的书上跑 mrsequential，把输出排序。

beats.text: Then mergeOutput sorts all your mr-out files together into one file.
beats.zh: 然后 mergeOutput 把你所有的 mr-out 文件合在一起排序。

beats.text: And runCmp compares the two, byte for byte. Our real run: identical.
beats.zh: 最后 runCmp 把两个文件逐字节比较。我们的真实运行：完全相同。

beats.text: Suppose "of" ended up in two buckets. What happens?
beats.zh: 假如 "of" 进了两个桶，会怎样？

beats.text: Two lines start with "of", each with part of the count. cmp finds the difference, and the test fails.
beats.zh: 会有两行以 "of" 开头，各带一部分次数。cmp 找到不同，测试失败。

beats.text: We ran the whole page in one process, with nothing going wrong.
beats.zh: 我们是在一个进程里跑完整张图的，什么错都没出。

beats.text: Who hands each row and column to a worker, and what happens when a worker dies halfway?
beats.zh: 谁把每一行、每一列派给 worker？worker 做到一半死了怎么办？

beats.text: And how do you stop a half-written mr-X-Y from being read? That's episode 3.
beats.zh: 怎么防止别人读到写了一半的 mr-X-Y？这些是第 3 集。

beats.text: How the pairs are written inside each file is your choice. The lab suggests JSON, one pair at a time.
beats.zh: 每个文件里词对怎么写由你决定。Lab 建议用 JSON，一次写一个。

beats.text: One: M map tasks times R reduce buckets. Eight times ten, eighty files.
beats.zh: 一：M 个 map 任务乘 R 个 reduce 桶。八乘十，八十个文件。

beats.text: Two: ihash mod nReduce picks the column, so every copy of a word meets in one reducer.
beats.zh: 二：ihash 对 nReduce 取余决定列，同一个词的所有副本会在同一个 reducer 汇合。

beats.text: Three: reduce reads a whole column, so it waits at the gate for every map task.
beats.zh: 三：reduce 读一整列，所以要在闸门前等所有 map 任务完成。

beats.text: Your turn: hash "the" by hand. Three bytes: 0x74, 0x68, 0x65.
beats.zh: 轮到你：手算 "the" 的哈希。三个字节：0x74、0x68、0x65。

beats.text: Which bucket does it go to? Careful with the mask this time.
beats.zh: 它进几号桶？这次小心掩码。

beats.text: The hash is 3,020,861,980. The mask clears the top bit: 873,378,332. Mod 10: bucket 2.
And mr-out-2 says: the 29748. Next episode: the coordinator, crashes, and atomic rename.
beats.zh: mr-out-2 里写着：the 29748。下一集：协调者、崩溃和原子改名。
